messages:
Maria: Quick FYI — access review kickoff Monday. Need to handle ephemeral admin rotations and exception docs.

Raj: Do we have a process for exceptions tied to KMS-bound service accounts? I found a few ownerless keys in the last scan.

Chris: We have a spreadsheet but it's out of date. Suggestion: require short-lived IAM grants + enforce an 'owner' tag on KMS grants. cc @Elly for owner-tag enforcement.

Elly: Agree. Proposal: automated check that flags KMS grants without an 'owner' tag and creates a tracker issue. If flagged, auto-notify the team in the ticket.

Maria: Audit question — how do we capture who performed manual admin elevations? Cloud audit logs show the principal but not the ephemeral session id consistently.

security-bot: We can surface STS session name in the audit trail. Add session_tagging to assume-role flows and add trace_id=access-review-<ts> to the logs for correlation.

Raj: For exceptions during the review window, require a ticket with justification + expiry <= 7d. Longer exceptions need Security lead signoff. Also capture the mitigation plan.

Chris: What about on-prem HSM/KMS? Our current scanner only hits cloud KMS. We need to add the HSM key registry to the audit.

Elly: I'll open a PR to extend the audit runner. Sample usage in the PR: 
```
./scripts/kms-audit.sh --since 7d --tag owner
# outputs CSV: key_id,svcacct,owner,expires
```

Maria: :thumbsup: Also add a rollback playbook for accidental admin prune. Add a 24h canary hold before any bulk revoke so we can revert quickly.

Raj: Compliance wants an evidence bundle export for each review. We'll store bundles in encrypted S3 with envelope encryption and include a SHA256 of the relevant audit logs.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: kms-audit run set for Mon 01:00 UTC. Findings will be posted to #eng-security and the compliance bucket.

Chris: I'll consolidate an exception template and run a dry-run Wednesday. Who can help triage ownerless keys?

Maria: I can do first pass. @Raj can you map cloud KMS keys to on-prem HSM entries?

Raj: Yep, I’ll handle the KMS/HSM mapping and add a small matcher for key aliases.

Elly: PR opened with scanning code + issue template. Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/access-review

security-bot: Reminder: retention policy requires keeping audit evidence for 2 years. Tagging this thread #compliance.

Maria: Thanks team — aim to start Monday. If you spot any high-risk cross-account grants, ping me immediately so we can triage before the review window.

Chris: SG.

Raj: On it.

Elly: Will follow up with the PR link and a quick demo in the sync.
